name: L03-fix
delta:
SEED ROLES. The FIRST image is the crowd exemplar — use its anonymous crowd proportion, face tier and the bounded 2-3 flat head-tone set it repeats; take nothing of its dress, period or setting, which each scene authors for itself.

A hotel function room seen from the floor: a low awards dais stage-right stands empty under one hard overhead spot, an oversized display board angled on it with its face completely blank and unlettered, a lectern stage-left with nobody behind it. Beyond a velvet rope across the midground the rear of the room is packed with a banquet crowd up on their feet applauding hard at the empty dais, beaming, every crowd figure drawn on the flat CROWD RIG only - dot eyes, one simple mouth, no individuated eyebrow or mouth linework on any face beyond that flat rig, hair and headwear repeating across at most 2-3 shared silhouettes for the whole group and never a distinct style invented per figure. Pleated gold curtain wall behind them, banquet tables running back through the depth, gold-cream-charcoal palette, dim room light against the one hot spot, foreground depth from a cropped banquet chair back at the lower-left.

prompt_suffix: Clean flat 2.5D vector cartoon in The Second Take house style: even medium-thick dark warm brown-black (#241a12) outline on everything, flat cel colours with gentle soft shading, rounded friendly shapes, no realistic detail; built-but-flat environment (flat gradient sky/ground + minimal geometry + one foreground depth prop); any in-world lettering hand-lettered in the marker style, short and legible; locked 2-3 colour scene palette plus the single red accent #d7402b used only semantically (alarm / prohibition / ownership / the last punch element); no photorealism, no on-screen narrator or host face, no unrequested text, no logos; 16:9.
